label: validate-binary-xattr-tar-format
command: import json,base64,tarfile,io,pathlib,subprocess; from sys import path; path.insert(0,"tools");from erofs_metadata import inventory; d=json.load(open("research/candidates/mi8937-os4/inode-metadata.json"))["paths"]; cap=next(v["xattrs_base64"] for v in d.values() if "security.capability" in v["xattrs_base64"]);p=pathlib.Path("downloads/xattr-fixture.tar");t=tarfile.open(p,"w",format=tarfile.PAX_FORMAT);a=tarfile.TarInfo(".");a.type=tarfile.DIRTYPE;a.mode=493;t.addfile(a);a=tarfile.TarInfo("file");a.size=1;a.mode=493;a.pax_headers={"SCHILY.xattr."+k:base64.b64decode(v).decode("utf-8","surrogateescape") for k,v in cap.items()};t.addfile(a,io.BytesIO(b"x"));t.close();subprocess.run(["tools/local/usr/bin/mkfs.erofs","--tar=f","downloads/xattr-fixture.img",str(p)],check=True);actual=inventory(pathlib.Path("downloads/xattr-fixture.img"),"tools/local/usr/bin/dump.erofs")["paths"]["file"]["xattrs_base64"];assert actual==cap,(actual,cap);print("binary capability and SELinux label roundtrip passed")
